$Comment: Inkwell_Role_Pack_Rat — rats that form a swarm DYNAMICALLY when one aggros. Rats wander solo; when a lone rat senses a player it runs the custom Inkwell_RecruitFlock action, which creates an engine flock, recruits up to FlockSize-1 same-role rats within FlockRadius, and locks the player as every member's LockedTarget (so recruits that never saw the player still converge). The engine then handles leader election/succession-on-death, size cap, and dissolve-below-2; Inkwell_FlockAttackToken (groups by flock id) serialises the attack so one rat at a time darts in, bites, and retreats. Combat is keyed on the marked LockedTarget (a Target sensor), NOT a fresh Player sense, so far recruits engage. The pack disperses when the target is lost: a 'Disband' alarm is re-armed every tick the target is within leash, so it only 'Passes' ~5s after the target was last seen, at which point members LeaveFlock and go back to wandering. Generic role (a Variant can't carry Instructions). Inkwell_RecruitFlock + Inkwell_FlockAttackToken are registered by InkwellPlugin.setup().

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the pack rat (matches the vanilla Rat).

Instructions.$Comment: AGGRO -> FORM A PACK. A lone (not-yet-flocked) rat that senses a player within 18 forms a flock: the recruit action pulls in nearby same-role rats and locks the player on all of them. Continue so the recruiter proceeds into combat the same tick (it just joined its own flock).

IN A PACK. Combat is driven by the shared LockedTarget (set by the recruit action), so members chase/attack even with no line of sight. One token holder bites at a time; the rest ring the target; the pack disbands when the target is lost.

Re-arm the disband timer every tick the target is within leash (35). While engaged the alarm is always ~5s in the future, so it never Passes; once the target is lost it Passes ~5s later. Continue so combat still runs this tick.
Target lost for ~5s (alarm Passed): leave the flock and go back to wandering. Engine dissolves the flock once it drops below 2.
TOKEN HOLDER: this rat owns the attack turn. Rush the marked target; bite once only when in range; then retreat (per-rat Bit flag), holding through the swing so the hit lands.
In bite range and not yet bitten this turn: face + bite ONCE, hold through the swing (Timeout), then raise the Bit flag so the retreat branch takes over.
Already bit this turn: retreat to the ring (hit-and-run). Still the token holder, so no one else engages early.
Holding the token, not yet in range: rush the marked target.
NON-HOLDER: clear the Bit flag (so our next turn bites fresh) and hold/strafe at 5-7 blocks from the marked target, visibly waiting our turn.
Not in a pack and nothing to aggro: wander solo.
